prompt: In some families, young children are cared for during the working day by their grandparents. Others believe that professional nurseries provide a better start. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Nowadays, both of the parents usually work, so somebody must look after the small children during the day. In some families the grandparents do this job, but other families prefer to send the child to the professional nursery. In this essay I will discuss the both opinions and give my own opinion.

Firstly, many people think that the grandparents are the best choice. The main reason is that they love the child very much and they will take care of him with the great attention. Also, the child feel safe because he knows his grandmother and grandfather from the birth. Another reason is the money, because the nursery is very expensive nowadays and many young family cannot afford it. Furthermore, the grandparents can teach the traditions and the language of the family to the child.

On the other hand, some people prefer the nursery. In the nursery the staff are trained and they know how to develop the skills of the children. Moreover, the child can play with the other children of the same age, so he learn how to share and how to make the friends. This is very important for the social development. Also the nursery has the special toys and the activities which the grandparents do not have in the home.

In conclusion, the grandparents give the love and the nursery gives the education. In my opinion the best solution is to use the both of them, for example the nursery in the morning and the grandparents in the afternoon.
title: Grandparents or nurseries for young children
